description: Hyperparameter grids for every model in the benchmark. Each list holds the candidate values for one hyperparameter; every combination is tried on the dev split, the one with the best dev score is selected, and only that one is run on the test split. A single-value list is a fixed setting. Names follow each library's own argument names where a setting maps to one. Similarities and match probabilities are in [0, 1]. Which fields to compare is dataset-specific and not part of this file.

blocking.description: Candidate generation shared by every method on a dataset: TF-IDF character n-grams and the top-k most similar records per record. The smallest top_k whose pair completeness on dev reaches target_pair_completeness is frozen for all methods.

baselines.description: Reference points every other method must beat.

graph_clustering.description: Clustering of the scored candidate graph. threshold drops edges whose similarity is below it before clustering.

embedding_clustering.description: Clustering of records directly in an embedding space. min_cluster_size and min_samples are 2 and 1 because library defaults treat true duplicate pairs as noise; noise points become singletons.

active_learning.description: A random forest on the candidate pairs' similarity features that asks a simulated oracle (answering from the dev entities' ground truth) about the pairs it is least sure of. It starts from initial_labels random pairs, then queries query_batch_size pairs per round, those whose match probability is closest to 0.5, until label_budget labels are used.

supervised.description: Upper bound: pair classifiers trained on similarity features of labelled dev pairs. threshold is the predicted match probability above which a pair counts as a match.
